decisions.speaker: owner
decisions.words: 3:Each gas unit that ignites should create its own weak explosion that then whooshes along, detonating each gas cloud along the entire pattern. The backwash should scatter items not just in the cloud but within the radius of any of the individual explosions. Like 3:3 but I want to make sure each of the individual gas clumps gets it, not just "the centroid of the large gas cloud"
decisions.what: Igniting gas chains clump by clump; each clump makes its own weak explosion that scatters goods in its own radius, inside or outside the gas. Never one centroid blast.

contradictions.text: Built: goods vanish and reappear with a dust puff. Ruled 2026-11-10: they visibly fly, rotate, bounce off walls losing energy. Build owed (a thrown-thing carrier), not a question.
Built and walked: items on any storage building stay. Ruled 2026-11-10: ordinary shelves give no exemption. Defect: remove the skip for open shelves, flip walk row item_on_a_shelf_stays.
Ruled 2026-11-10: each igniting gas clump makes its own weak explosion. Nothing built anywhere does this; no gas in our mods currently explodes when lit.
Ruled Q1 'everywhere: every blast throws'. Built: fire blasts throw nothing and other mods' explosions throw at 0% by default. Decision for him (open question 2).
Ruled Q10: goods in a pit stay retrievable. Only a lowered ladder reaches them; no scene proves a colonist fetches one. Proof owed, not a question.

failure_modes: It looks like teleporting, not a blast: goods blink to new cells under a dust puff, so the scatter he asked to watch (flying, spinning, bouncing loot) never happens, and every row reads green.

It looks green but isn't: the live scenes were last green 2026-10-06 on a staged site with the old rules (shelf exemption, instant items); since then his 2026-11-10 rulings and the gas chain exist only on paper, so in a real raid the mod may not match what he ruled and nothing he walks would show which.

The spectacle costs the game: a mortar into a stockpile, or a gas cloud going off clump by clump, spawns dozens of flying stacks at once; either the game stutters or the caps silently leave most goods unmoved, and both read to him as broken.

root_draft.speaker: agent
root_draft.text: Every blast in RimWorld now throws what it hits. A mortar shell beside a colonist hurls them three cells straight away from it, clean over sandbags, until a wall stops them hard; anything light goes too, so loose goods and corpses fly through the air, spinning and rebounding off walls, and no open shelf keeps them safe. When gas catches, it goes off clump by clump, each small burst scattering whatever lies near it, as the fire whooshes through the whole cloud. And where a blast meets a pit, its cover breaks and whoever it throws in falls.
